lines.text: Beacon calls the return close. Your record has a different tune coming back. I know what a return signal looks like. I don't know what sets this delay.
The copied echo labels a familiar voice with an unfamiliar name. That is the echo's label. I'd check a signal twice before trusting its filing.
The third listener's log says the name repeats wrong. A fault in the voice or a fault in the recording? I've repaired enough lines to check both ends.
Three cells, decant frequency. One out of phase on your record. I used to fix rails by measuring them. I'd keep that phase plot before naming a voice.
Three cells. Bring the readings back as readings. Mother can argue about what they mean.
Listening jobs. We pay for what you hear, not what you kill.
Rails hum at forty hertz. Under Chapel Ward they hum at forty-one. That's not the rails.
